description: This file defines a React context provider 'DataProvider' that manages global state for Jira and Confluence data within a frontend application. It includes state, actions, reducers, and methods for fetching, selecting, and error handling of Jira projects and Confluence spaces, as well as resource fetching. It also provides a React hook 'useData' for consuming this context.

methods.name: fetchJiraProjects
methods.description: Fetches Jira projects with caching logic based on last fetch time, updates state, and handles errors.

methods.name: selectJiraProject
methods.description: Sets the currently selected Jira project.

methods.name: getJiraProjectDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific Jira project from the API.

methods.name: clearJiraError
methods.description: Clears any Jira-related errors from the context state.

methods.name: fetchConfluenceSpaces
methods.description: Fetches Confluence spaces with caching based on last fetch time, updates state, and handles errors.

methods.name: selectConfluenceSpace
methods.description: Sets the currently selected Confluence space.

methods.name: getConfluenceSpaceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific Confluence space from the API.

methods.name: getConfluenceSpaceContent
methods.description: Fetches content from a Confluence space based on space key and content type.

methods.name: clearConfluenceError
methods.description: Clears any Confluence-related errors from the context state.

methods.name: fetchResources
methods.description: Fetches resources for the specified service ('jira' or 'confluence') and updates state.

methods.name: clearAllErrors
methods.description: Clears all error states in the context.

methods.name: refreshAllData
methods.description: Triggers refetching of Jira projects and Confluence spaces, forcing refresh.
